N. B. The*न् of the substitute is changed to ण् when preceded 
by र् belonging to the first member ending in अ; as सर्वाह्ण:; but 
परगतं अह: पराह्न: (as परा ends in आ).

(d) † तक्षन् when preceded by ग्राम or कौट, and श्वन् by अति or 
an inanimate object with which it is compounded; e. g. ग्रामस्य 
तक्षा ग्रामतक्ष: 'a village carpenter i. e. one not very skilful,' कुत्स्यो 
भव: कौट: (स्वतन्त्र: ) स चासौ तक्षा च कौटतक्ष: 'an independent 
carpenter'; अतिश्व: [दराह्:] 'fleeter than a dog'; अतिश्वी (worse 
than a dog's life) सेवा; आकष्टे: श्वा इव आकर्षश्व: 'a dog like i. e. 
bad or unlucky throw of dice,' but वानरश्वा 'a monkey like 
a dog'.

(e) ‡ सक्थिन् when preceded by उत्तर, मृग or पूर्व or by a word 
denoting an inanimate object with which it is compounded; 
उत्तरसक्थम् 'the upper part of the thigh', मृगसक्थम् 'the thigh of 
a deer,' पूर्वसक्थम्, फलकामिव सक्थिन् फलकसक्थम् 'a thigh like a 
board'.

(f) A numeral when compounded in a Tat. त्रिंशति त्रिंशत्: 
त्रिंशति वर्षाणि (चैत्रस्य) more than thirty; त्रिंशत्: त्रिंशतांगुलिभ्य: 
त्रिंशत्: खड्ग: a sword more than thirty fingers in length.
